items.title: Kenny Davern interviewed by Michael Woods, Clinton, New York, September 23, 1995 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: “Laverne’ll leave the light on for ya.”

ctx.x: That’s it, the Gomer Pyle routine, yeah. “Laverne’ll leave the light on for ya.” And they didn’t expect that. And I think that you have to disarm your audience in order to just, okay, get rid of all this nonsense, and then maybe we can partake in a rapport. But if you feel that freeze or that chill, you can’t really loosen up and play.
Or it may take you three tunes to get through it.
